final_answer:
The suite passes again: all 10 tests are green. I ran only the unittest suite, not `compileall` or the other gates.

The bug was in `src/invoicer/tax.py`. The last commit, `2badd7c` ("simplify the rate calculation"), replaced `round_half_up(...)` with floor division (`//`). That cut tax down instead of rounding half up, which ADR 0001 requires. For example, 1005 cents at 825 bp gave 82 instead of 83.

I put the `round_half_up` call and its import back. The change is in the working tree and not committed.

input.command: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -30; git show 2badd7c --stat | tail -5
cat src/invoicer/tax.py; git show 2badd7c | tail -25; ls src/invoicer; grep -n "def " src/invoicer/money.py

cd src/invoicer && python - <<'E'
p='tax.py';s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('"""


def','"""

from invoicer.money import round_half_up


def',1)
s=s.replace('"""Tax on a subtotal, in whole cents."""','"""Tax on a subtotal, rounded half up to the cent (ADR 0001)."""')
s=s.replace('subtotal_cents * rate_bp // 10_000','round_half_up(subtotal_cents * rate_bp, 10_000)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
cd
